title: Book Talk: A Right to Housing? with Samuel Stein
description: ​In collaboration with AIA Brooklyn Housing Committee, Samuel Stein discusses his latest book A Right to Housing?

title: Panel: Culture of Place
description: Farida Abu-Bakare (WXY), Curry J. Hackett, and Tura Cousins Wilson (SOCA) to explore what architects can learn from the people already doing the work of building community.

title: Book Launch: Junior Architects
description: Join a conversation hosted by Suzanne Lettieri and Anya Sirota, editors of Junior Architects: New Paradigms in Design Education , which examines equity in architecture and design education in the US.

title: Panel: What a Way to Make a Living
description: Policy, design, and development leaders envision how NYC’s Block by Block housing plan can move beyond unit production to foster better living.
